title: 4041. Minimum Operations to Form Subset Sum II

examples.explanation: Divide nums[0] = 10 once: 10 → 5, costing 1 operation. Multiply nums[1] = 2 twice: 2 → 4 → 8, costing 2 operations. After these operations, nums = [5, 8]. The subset {5, 8} sums to 13 using 3 operations in total.
Turn nums[1] = 3 into 2 using 2 operations: Divide nums[1] to get 1. Multiply nums[1] = 1 to get 2. After these operations, nums = [6, 2]. The subset {6, 2} sums to 8 using 2 operations in total.
No sequence of operations lets a subset of nums sum to 7, so the answer is -1.
